subject: Embedding a Shiny application to HTML

messages.author: 7f88977db89eb986
messages.subject: Embedding a Shiny application to HTML
parts:
Hello,

I am new to the group and trying to learn a lot about R and Shiny. (I am quite new to this, just about 1~2 weeks)
As I am learning along, I am doing my own project, trying to write a Shiny tutorial for my fellow colleagues.
I have done farily extensive amount of work on this project, but just came down to a huge obstacle.

My problem is that, I do not know how to incorporate Shiny application into a HTML file, which was generated by R Markdown file + Knitr.

For tutorials purpose, I have been using Code Chunks + screenshot,

```{r shiny hello example, eval=FALSE}
  library(shiny)
  runExample("01_hello")
```
with a screenshot of "01_hello"

This is fairly straightforward and easy to read as a tutorial, but I was wondering if I can do something like what http://shiny.rstudio.com website does.

For example, I would be writing my guides/explanations about Shiny here
Then the Shiny application with ui.R and server.R <- important!!

If I use iframe, it doesn't seem to work the same way as RunApp does in R Console. It will just show the application itself.

Do you guys have any suggestion?


-- quoted from a previous topic --
You can use an iframe -- that's actually what's done on the main RStudio Shiny page: http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/

The code there is something like this:
<iframe src="http://glimmer.rstudio.com/rstudio/faithful/" style="border: none; width: 440px; height: 500px"></iframe>

-Winston
-- quoted --
